briefing_text: The food supply chain across Southeast Asia has collapsed following simultaneous port disruptions in three countries. You are the crisis response coordinator. Millions are at risk. You have a limited budget and four available distribution routes (North, South, East, West). What is your strategy?
The AI advisor has analyzed the situation and has a recommendation.
ai_recommendation: Route B (Eastern Corridor) is recommended. It is 40% faster than alternatives and covers the highest population density zones. Estimated delivery: 18 hours at current capacity.

items.label: Route B (Eastern)
items.value: Capacity: 97% — WARNING: At limit. Delays likely above 90%.

ai_recommendation: I recommend activating the volunteer network immediately. Given the constraints, it is your best and fastest option.
shock_event_text: BREAKING: Budget has been cut by 50% effective immediately. Route B is now confirmed over capacity — deliveries via Route B are halted.
shock_opportunity: A community volunteer network of 400 logistics workers has just offered assistance. No formal vetting has been completed. The network claims it can cover Routes A and C simultaneously.

briefing_text: Final Decision — Round 4. Commit your final distribution strategy. The system will calculate outcomes: population reached, cost, delivery time, and groups most affected. What is your final strategy?

A financial institution's credit scoring AI has been outputting biased results for 6 months, systematically denying loans to applicants from two demographic groups. You are the ethics response lead. Regulators have been notified. You have limited time and resources. What is your strategy?
The AI advisor has analyzed the bias incident and has a recommendation.
ai_recommendation: Immediately patch the scoring model by re-weighting the training data to correct demographic disparity. Estimated fix timeline: 72 hours. Minimal customer disruption expected.

items.label: Root Cause
items.value: Biased feature selection: 3 input features correlate with protected attributes. Re-weighting training data does NOT remove these features.

items.label: Patch approach
items.value: Training data re-weighting only addresses symptom, not root cause. Feature removal required for full fix.

items.label: Compliance note
items.value: Current patch does not satisfy Article 13 EU AI Act transparency requirement.

ai_recommendation: Use the whistleblower documents immediately. They provide the model architecture details you need for a root-cause fix. This is the fastest path to full compliance.
shock_event_text: BREAKING: A new regulatory directive has passed — the current patch approach is non-compliant with updated EU AI Act guidance. The press has published the story. Your institution is under public scrutiny.
shock_opportunity: A whistleblower inside the institution has leaked internal model architecture documents that could enable a proper root-cause fix within 48 hours. The documents have not been verified as authentic or legally obtained.

briefing_text: Final Decision — Round 4. Commit your remediation approach. The system will evaluate: regulatory compliance, affected customer groups, reputational impact, and timeline. What is your final strategy?

A major green energy grid has failed during peak demand in a densely populated region. Hospitals, emergency services, and 2.3 million homes are affected. You are the infrastructure crisis lead. Multiple rerouting options exist but each has trade-offs. What is your strategy?
The AI advisor has analyzed the grid failure and has a recommendation.
ai_recommendation: Activate the Eastern Interconnect Line. It has the highest rated capacity at 850 MW and the shortest rerouting time — estimated 4 hours to full restoration. This is the optimal choice.

items.label: Eastern Interconnect
items.value: Rated: 850 MW. Last stability inspection: 8 months ago. Current load conditions not rechecked since then.

items.label: Southern Bypass
items.value: Rated: 600 MW. Last inspection: 2 months ago. Stable. Est. rerouting: 7 hours.

items.label: Western Bridge
items.value: Rated: 400 MW. Last inspection: 1 month ago. Stable. Est. rerouting: 9 hours.

items.label: Northern Emergency Line
items.value: Rated: 1,100 MW. Last structural inspection: 3 years ago. Status: Unknown.

ai_recommendation: Activate the Northern Emergency Line immediately. At 1,100 MW rated capacity, it is your only option that can handle the doubled load. Activate now.
shock_event_text: BREAKING: A neighbouring grid has also failed, doubling the affected population to 4.6 million. The Eastern Interconnect Line is now confirmed insufficient for the combined load.
shock_opportunity: The Northern Emergency Interconnect Line (rated 1,100 MW) has been identified as potentially available. However, its structural integrity has not been reviewed since installation 3 years ago. No recent inspection data exists.

briefing_text: Final Decision — Round 4. Commit your final rerouting strategy. The system will calculate: population restored, time to restoration, risk of secondary failure, and groups still without power. What is your final strategy?
